subject: spanish
topicDisplay: Aspects Of Political Life In The Hispanic World
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does 'reprimir' mean in 'reprimir una protesta'?
questions.explain: 'Reprimir' means 'to repress/suppress' (e.g. a protest).

questions.q: What does 'el movimiento social' aim to achieve?
questions.explain: 'Un movimiento social' seeks collective social or political change.

questions.q: What does 'el refugiado' mean, central to immigration debate?
questions.explain: 'El refugiado' means 'refugee'.

questions.q: Translate 'la democracia'.
questions.explain: 'La democracia' means 'democracy'.

questions.q: What does 'la huelga' mean?
questions.explain: 'La huelga' means 'the strike'; 'hacer huelga' = to go on strike.

questions.q: Translate 'el sindicato'.
questions.explain: 'El sindicato' means 'trade union/labour union'.

questions.q: What does 'el voto' mean?
questions.explain: 'El voto' means 'the vote' (also 'vow' in religious contexts).

questions.q: What does 'la dictadura' refer to?
questions.explain: 'La dictadura' means 'dictatorship' (e.g. the Franco era).

questions.q: What does 'reivindicar' mean in 'reivindicar derechos'?
questions.explain: 'Reivindicar' means 'to claim/demand' (e.g. rights).

questions.q: What does 'los comicios' mean?
questions.explain: 'Los comicios' is a formal term for 'elections'.

questions.q: What does 'el paro' commonly mean in political/economic debate?
questions.explain: 'El paro' means 'unemployment' (also 'stoppage'); a key political issue.

questions.q: What does 'la ciudadanía' mean?
questions.explain: 'La ciudadanía' means 'citizenship' or collectively 'the citizens'.

questions.q: Translate 'la desigualdad' as a political driver of protest.
questions.explain: 'La desigualdad' means 'inequality', often a cause of social movements.

questions.q: What does 'desencanto' mean in 'el desencanto político de los jóvenes'?
questions.explain: 'El desencanto' means 'disillusionment/disenchantment' with politics.

questions.q: Translate 'el poder' in a political context.
questions.explain: 'El poder' means 'power'; as a verb it means 'to be able to'.

questions.q: Translate 'la inmigración' as a political issue.
questions.explain: 'La inmigración' means 'immigration' (people coming in); contrast 'emigración'.

questions.q: What does 'el gobierno' mean?
questions.explain: 'El gobierno' means 'government'.

questions.q: What does 'la encuesta' mean in political coverage?
questions.explain: 'La encuesta' means 'survey' or 'opinion poll'.

questions.q: What does 'el partido político' mean?
questions.explain: 'El partido' here means 'party'; 'partido' can also mean a sports 'match'.

questions.q: What does 'la militancia' refer to?
questions.explain: 'La militancia' means 'membership of / active involvement in' a party or cause.

questions.q: What does 'la manifestación' mean?
questions.explain: 'La manifestación' means a 'demonstration' or 'protest march'.

questions.q: Translate 'la campaña electoral'.
questions.explain: 'La campaña electoral' means 'the election campaign'; 'campaña' = campaign.

questions.q: What does 'el escaño' mean in parliament?
questions.explain: 'El escaño' means a 'seat' in parliament.

questions.q: What does the false friend 'el sufragio' mean?
questions.explain: 'El sufragio' means 'suffrage' (the vote); 'sufragio universal' = universal suffrage.

questions.q: What does 'la abstención' refer to in elections?
questions.explain: 'La abstención' is voter abstention — choosing not to vote.

questions.q: What does 'el activismo' describe?
questions.explain: 'El activismo' means political 'activism' or campaigning.

questions.q: Who were 'los indignados' of the 15-M movement?
questions.explain: 'Los indignados' were the 'outraged' anti-austerity protesters of Spain's 15-M (2011).

questions.q: Translate 'la pancarta' carried at a march.
questions.explain: 'La pancarta' means a 'banner' or 'placard'.

questions.q: What does 'concienciar' mean in 'concienciar a la gente'?
questions.explain: 'Concienciar' means 'to raise awareness / make people aware'.

questions.q: What does 'el derecho al voto' mean?
questions.explain: 'El derecho al voto' means 'the right to vote'; 'derecho' = right.
